
=== WebPanel: Produccion.listarSilos ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Silo'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarSilosColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarSilosColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	SiloNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	SiloCapacidad.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	SiloKgMinimo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	SiloKgMaximo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	SiloEstadoMaterial.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	SiloTipoMaterial.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	SiloActivo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'SiloNombre'
					&TFSiloNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFSiloNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'SiloCapacidad'
					&TFSiloCapacidad.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFSiloCapacidad_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'SiloKgMinimo'
					&TFSiloKgMinimo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFSiloKgMinimo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'SiloKgMaximo'
					&TFSiloKgMaximo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFSiloKgMaximo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'SiloEstadoMaterial'
					&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelsJson.Replace(!'"', ''))
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'SiloTipoMaterial'
					&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'SiloActivo'
					&TFSiloActivo_Sel.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&UserActionArchivar = "Archivar"
	
	&Display = "GXM_display"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Display)
		&Display.Link = gestionarSilo.Link(TrnMode.Display, SiloId)
	Endif
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = gestionarSilo.Link(TrnMode.Update, SiloId)
	Endif
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = gestionarSilo.Link(TrnMode.Delete, SiloId)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'Produccion.listarSilosColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Produccion.listarSilosFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Produccion.listarSilosFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Produccion.listarSilosFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &UserActionArchivar.Click (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&SiloId_Selected = SiloId
	DVelop_ConfirmPanel_UserActionArchivar.Confirm()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DVelop_ConfirmPanel_UserActionArchivar.Close (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If DVelop_ConfirmPanel_UserActionArchivar.Result = !'Yes'
		Do 'Do UserActionArchivar'
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DocmdAgregar' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_cmdAgregar)
		gestionarSilo.Call(TrnMode.Insert, &SiloId)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoExport' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	// Generate Excel spreadsheet and download it.
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	listarSilosExport.Call(&ExcelFilename, &ErrorMessage)
	If (&ExcelFilename <> "")
		Link(&ExcelFilename)
	Else
		msg(&ErrorMessage)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Transaction: DB.Silo ===

--- Start (Event) ---

--- After Trn (Event) ---


=== Procedure: Produccion.ArchivarSilos ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&Silo.Load(&SiloId)
&Silo.SiloActivo = false
&Silo.Save()

If &Silo.Success()
	Commit
	Msg('Silo archivado')
	listarSilos.Call()
Else
	Msg('No se pudo archivar el silo')
EndIf

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&SiloId);


=== WebPanel: Produccion.gestionarSilo ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&AuditTableName = !'Silo'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&LoadSuccess = True
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Display)
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'silo_Insert'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Update AND WWPBaseObjects.SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'silo_Update'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'silo_Delete'))
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Insert
			&Silo.Load(&SiloId)
			&LoadSuccess = &Silo.Success()
			If not &LoadSuccess
				&Messages = &Silo.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Display OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				Silo_SiloActivo.Enabled = False
				Silo_SiloNombre.Enabled = False
				Silo_SiloCapacidad.Enabled = False
				Silo_SiloKgMinimo.Enabled = False
				Silo_SiloKgMaximo.Enabled = False
				Silo_SiloEstadoMaterial.Enabled = False
				Silo_SiloTipoMaterial.Enabled = False
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		&LoadSuccess = False
	EndIf
	If &LoadSuccess
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
			msg('GXM_confdelete')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Do 'AttributesSecurityCode'
	wcAuditoria.Object = AuditHistoryById.Create(&AuditTableName, &SiloId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Enter (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode <> GeneXus.TrnMode.Display
		If &TrnMode <> GeneXus.TrnMode.Delete
			Do 'CheckRequiredFields'
		EndIf
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete OR &CheckRequiredFieldsResult
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&Silo.Delete()
			Else
				&Silo.Save()
			EndIf
			If &Silo.Success()
				Do 'After_Trn'
			Else
				&Messages = &Silo.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(in:&TrnMode, in:&SiloId);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Produccion.listarSilosExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"listarSilosExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSiloNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Nombre")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFSiloNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFSiloNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Nombre")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFSiloNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSiloCapacidad.IsEmpty() AND &TFSiloCapacidad_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Capacidad (kg)")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFSiloCapacidad
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFSiloCapacidad_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSiloKgMinimo.IsEmpty() AND &TFSiloKgMinimo_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Mínimo (kg)")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFSiloKgMinimo
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFSiloKgMinimo_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSiloKgMaximo.IsEmpty() AND &TFSiloKgMaximo_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Máximo (kg)")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFSiloKgMaximo
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFSiloKgMaximo_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels.Count = 0)
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Estado de Material")
		&i = 1
		For &TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sel in &TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = ''
			Else
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text += ', '
			EndIf
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text += &TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sel.EnumerationDescription()
			&i += 1
		EndFor
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels.Count = 0)
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Tipo de Material")
		&i = 1
		For &TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sel in &TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = ''
			Else
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text += ', '
			EndIf
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text += &TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sel.EnumerationDescription()
			&i += 1
		EndFor
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSiloActivo_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Silo Activo")
		Do Case
			Case &TFSiloActivo_Sel = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "WWP_TSChecked"
			Case &TFSiloActivo_Sel = 2
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "WWP_TSUnChecked"
		EndCase
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarSilosColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarSilosColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Silo
		order SiloNombre  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloCapacidad  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloCapacidad)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloKgMinimo  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloKgMinimo)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloKgMaximo  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloKgMaximo)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloEstadoMaterial  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloEstadoMaterial)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloTipoMaterial  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloTipoMaterial)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloActivo  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloActivo)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarSilosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFSiloNombre, &TFSiloNombre_Sel, &TFSiloCapacidad, &TFSiloCapacidad_To, &TFSiloKgMinimo
					, &TFSiloKgMinimo_To, &TFSiloKgMaximo, &TFSiloKgMaximo_To, &TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels, &TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels, &TFSiloActivo_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SiloNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(SiloNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SiloCapacidad'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = SiloCapacidad
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SiloKgMinimo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = SiloKgMinimo
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SiloKgMaximo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = SiloKgMaximo
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SiloEstadoMaterial'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = SiloEstadoMaterial.EnumerationDescription()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SiloTipoMaterial'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = SiloTipoMaterial.EnumerationDescription()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SiloActivo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = SiloActivo.ToString()
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SiloNombre", '', !'Nombre', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SiloCapacidad", '', !'Capacidad (kg)', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SiloKgMinimo", '', !'Mínimo (kg)', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SiloKgMaximo", '', !'Máximo (kg)', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SiloEstadoMaterial", '', !'Estado de Material', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SiloTipoMaterial", '', !'Tipo de Material', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SiloActivo", '', !'Silo Activo', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'Produccion.listarSilosColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarSilosGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarSilosGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarSilosGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILONOMBRE"
				&TFSiloNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFSiloNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOCAPACIDAD"
				&TFSiloCapacidad.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSiloCapacidad_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOKGMINIMO"
				&TFSiloKgMinimo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSiloKgMinimo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOKGMAXIMO"
				&TFSiloKgMaximo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSiloKgMaximo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOESTADOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOTIPOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFSiloActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

=== Procedure: Produccion.listarSilosExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'listarsilos_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Silo List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not &TFSiloNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFSiloNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFSiloNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFSiloNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSiloCapacidad.IsEmpty() AND &TFSiloCapacidad_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFSiloCapacidad
		&TFSiloCapacidad_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Capacidad (kg)", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFSiloCapacidad_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSiloKgMinimo.IsEmpty() AND &TFSiloKgMinimo_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFSiloKgMinimo
		&TFSiloKgMinimo_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Mínimo (kg)", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFSiloKgMinimo_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSiloKgMaximo.IsEmpty() AND &TFSiloKgMaximo_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFSiloKgMaximo
		&TFSiloKgMaximo_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Máximo (kg)", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFSiloKgMaximo_To
	EndIf
	&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelsJson)
	If not &TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels.Count = 0
		&i = 1
		For &TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sel in &TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelDscs = ''
			Else
				&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelDscs += ', '
			EndIf
			&FilterTFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelValueDescription = &TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sel.EnumerationDescription()

			&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelDscs += &FilterTFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelValueDescription
			&i += 1
		EndFor
		print printBlockTFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sel
	EndIf
	&TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
	If not &TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels.Count = 0
		&i = 1
		For &TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sel in &TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelDscs = ''
			Else
				&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelDscs += ', '
			EndIf
			&FilterTFSiloTipoMaterial_SelValueDescription = &TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sel.EnumerationDescription()

			&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelDscs += &FilterTFSiloTipoMaterial_SelValueDescription
			&i += 1
		EndFor
		print printBlockTFSiloTipoMaterial_Sel
	EndIf
	If not &TFSiloActivo_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Do Case
			Case &TFSiloActivo_Sel = 1
				&FilterTFSiloActivo_SelValueDescription = "WWP_TSChecked" 
			Case &TFSiloActivo_Sel = 2
				&FilterTFSiloActivo_SelValueDescription = "WWP_TSUnChecked" 
		EndCase

		print printBlockTFSiloActivo_Sel
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Silo
		order SiloNombre  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloCapacidad  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloCapacidad)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloKgMinimo  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloKgMinimo)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloKgMaximo  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloKgMaximo)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloEstadoMaterial  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloEstadoMaterial)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloTipoMaterial  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloTipoMaterial)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SiloActivo  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SiloActivo)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarSilosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFSiloNombre, &TFSiloNombre_Sel, &TFSiloCapacidad, &TFSiloCapacidad_To, &TFSiloKgMinimo
					, &TFSiloKgMinimo_To, &TFSiloKgMaximo, &TFSiloKgMaximo_To, &TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels, &TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels, &TFSiloActivo_Sel)
		&SiloEstadoMaterialDescription = SiloEstadoMaterial.EnumerationDescription()
		&SiloTipoMaterialDescription = SiloTipoMaterial.EnumerationDescription()

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarSilosGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarSilosGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarSilosGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILONOMBRE"
				&TFSiloNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFSiloNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOCAPACIDAD"
				&TFSiloCapacidad.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSiloCapacidad_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOKGMINIMO"
				&TFSiloKgMinimo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSiloKgMinimo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOKGMAXIMO"
				&TFSiloKgMaximo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSiloKgMaximo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOESTADOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOTIPOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFSiloActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: Produccion.listarSilosGetFilterData ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_SILONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadSiloNombreOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarSilosGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarSilosGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarSilosGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILONOMBRE"
				&TFSiloNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFSiloNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOCAPACIDAD"
				&TFSiloCapacidad.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSiloCapacidad_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOKGMINIMO"
				&TFSiloKgMinimo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSiloKgMinimo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOKGMAXIMO"
				&TFSiloKgMaximo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSiloKgMaximo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOESTADOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFSiloEstadoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOTIPOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFSiloTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSILOACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFSiloActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadSiloNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFSiloNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFSiloNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Silo
		Order SiloNombre
		using listarSilosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFSiloNombre, &TFSiloNombre_Sel, &TFSiloCapacidad, &TFSiloCapacidad_To, &TFSiloKgMinimo
					, &TFSiloKgMinimo_To, &TFSiloKgMaximo, &TFSiloKgMaximo_To, &TFSiloEstadoMaterial_Sels, &TFSiloTipoMaterial_Sels, &TFSiloActivo_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Silo
			Order SiloNombre
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not SiloNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = SiloNombre
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&DDOName, in:&SearchTxt, in:&SearchTxtTo, out:&OptionsJson, out:&OptionsDescJson, out:&OptionIndexesJson);
